sloka: अथ वायुसुतः क्रुद्धो रावणं समभिद्रवत् ।आजघानोरसि क्रुद्धो वज्रकल्पेन मुष्टिना ।। ६.५९.११४ ।।।।
transliteration: atha vāyusutaḥ kruddho rāvaṇaṁ samabhidravat ।ājaghānorasi kruddho vajrakalpena muṣṭinā ।। 6.59.114 ।।।।

translations.english: Thereafter, Ravana the enemy of Devatas was not capable of lifting Lakshmana's shoulders. Lakshmana could crush the pride of Rakshasas.
